example.description: Compute first and second derivatives of y=x² at the interior point of a nonuniform grid.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.geometry.numerics import diff_12_central

x = np.array([0.0, 0.3, 1.0])
first, second = diff_12_central(x, x * x)
np.testing.assert_allclose(first, [0.6])
np.testing.assert_allclose(second, [2.0])
example.expected: The interior estimates are first derivative [0.6] and second derivative [2.0].
